brief:
Israeli settlers began fencing agricultural land Monday near an existing outpost located in the Jabal al-Qarn area of al-Munya village, situated southeast of Bethlehem, Shehab Wire reported. The fencing operation targeted parcels of land directly adjacent to the settlement enclave. Settlers mobilized equipment and materials to demarcate the territory, a common preliminary step before formal land claims.

The action occurs in a region where Israeli outposts have expanded territorial control over Palestinian-owned land. Al-Munya village has faced repeated appropriation attempts as settlers push infrastructure deeper into areas south of Bethlehem. Monday's fencing represents an incremental expansion of the outpost's footprint in the occupied West Bank.
